presets.name: Away recap
presets.description: When the user steps away and comes back, Claude Code forks the main thread's whole conversation to ask for a recap of the session in under 40 words. Each fork reads the thread's full cached context for about 90 output tokens. The setting awaySummaryEnabled turns the feature off on one machine.

conditions.subject: message
conditions.value: ^The user stepped away and is coming back\. Recap in under 40 words

presets.name: Prompt suggestion
presets.description: In an interactive session Claude Code forks the main thread's whole conversation to predict what the user types next and shows the answer in the input. Each fork reads the thread's full cached context for about seven output tokens. The setting promptSuggestionEnabled turns the feature off on one machine.

conditions.subject: message
conditions.value: ^\[SUGGESTION MODE: Suggest what the user might naturally type next

presets.name: Subagent status summary
presets.description: Claude Code forks each running subagent's whole conversation every 30 seconds to ask for a status line of three to five words. Each fork reads the subagent's full cached context for about 24 output tokens, and no client setting turns it off. On one router the forks were 22 percent of every cached token read over three days. Blocking them leaves the Agent tool's status line static and changes nothing else.

conditions.subject: message
conditions.value: ^Describe your most recent action in 3-5 words
